title: Ft. Jackson Barracks Replacement
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SAD > US ARMY ENGINEER DISTRICT CHARLESTO
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), CHARLESTON District, is requesting market intelligence information to identify qualified industry partners capable of supporting a potential Repair and Replace, Design Build to Budget, Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under 10 U.S.C. 2808a for the stated Fort Jackson Barracks Replacement, Columbia, SC. See attachments.
